notes.title: A new title!
notes.content:
A new game is in the works!

In my previous game Tailor Tales, there was a small segment where you could chat online with your friends and love interest. Players loved this part and I got a lot of positive feedback about it. So I decided to use this segment and expand it into a fully playable game; a chat simulation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720182/7672ac537d2113368142b181886e7002b9589ee2.png[/img]

Still aimed at women, this game will allow you to customize your character as much as you want, including your gender. You can chat with characters and watch them interact with each other. But first, you have to meet them in an online game called Moonstone, which is an old-school style MMORPG that has been rebooted. There are many characters you can meet online and befriend, and eventually romance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44720182/3bcf35caa5ae6240170975d56b76a2296ba5a2e3.png[/img]
[i]Moonstone Remix will have a 3D hub-town where you can meet all the new characters.[/i]

Moonstone Remix is in early development, and thus any images shown are not final. Many things will change as the game goes through development.

I hope you are all excited about this next installment and to please consider adding this game to your wishlist! The wishlist will help out a lot!
